newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade centred on nearby soymeal.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade centred on nearby soymeal.

text.p: European feeds closed on Wednesday with scattered trades in soymeal pellets ahead of what is for many continental players a long holiday weekend.
"The market was quiet but that is to be expected with the pre-holiday mood prevailing. Many brokers closed their books at midday today," one trader said.
Prices were offered higher this morning for most products and there were few takers early on. The afternoon brought out a a little interest for afloat South American soymeal pellets.
Traders in the Netherlands and Germany are on holiday tomorrow, and many plan to take Friday off as well.
